caption:
This account posts twice a day. Nobody opens the app. Here is the whole setup.

1. An AI does the building. You describe what you want in plain English. You never write any code.

2. It designs every post. Words and picture together, in your colours, with your logo. You look through a week at a time and kill anything you do not like.

3. The pictures need a home. Instagram will not accept a file, it wants a web address and goes and fetches the image itself. A free host handles that. You drag one folder, once.

4. Instagram needs one key. This is the fiddly part. Your account has to be a business account, one permission is switched off by default, and the key quietly stops working after about sixty days.

5. A free timer publishes. It runs in the cloud rather than on your laptop, wakes every hour, and posts anything due.

6. Then you tell it your topics and leave it alone.

The full write up is free and includes everything that went wrong when we did it. Comment AUTOMATE and I will send it over.
